newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-F.A.CUP HERO PEARSON DIES AGED 78.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-F.A.CUP HERO PEARSON DIES AGED 78.

text.p: Stan Pearson, who scored what was effectively the winning goal for Manchester United in the 1948 F.A. Cup final has died aged 78.
Pearson, whose career at Old Trafford began as an amateur in 1935 and ended when he moved to Bury in 1954, scored 149 goals for United in 345 matches.

The highlights of his career were probably his two goals for England in their 2-1 win over Scotland in 1952 and his strike in the cup final against Blackpool, regarded as one of the best finals of all time.
Pearson scored to put United 3-2 ahead with 10 minutes of the match remaining and they went on to triumph 4-2 for their first trophy success under manager Matt Busby.
